lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are arranged in a series of roughly horizontal lanes. The spatial distribution shows a higher concentration of smaller centroids near the gill slits, expanding into a more sparse, grid-aligned configuration on the lateral mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical pixel intensity gradients form faint columnar bands that intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a series of anchor nodes most discernable in the upper half of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a distinct luminance transition from a high-intensity dorsal zone to a low-intensity shadow zone beneath the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal teleost fish exhibiting elongated dark profiles, clustered near the ventral aspect of the pectoral fin and along the lower lateral flank.
